trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) on v2.3.1 across all regions.
2. Attempted rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release), but it was rejected — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
3. Rolled back to v2.2.9 (the next most recent healthy production release), which is now rolled out in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.

Note: v2.3.0 remains quarantined and cannot be used as a rollback target until the CVE is addressed.
